lines: # The finish line of Sky Sprint: run as the runner, only while the clock runs
execute unless score #sky_sprint.clock.on msm_starter.msm_timers matches 1 run return 0
execute unless score @s msm_starter.sky_sprint.best matches 1.. run scoreboard players operation @s msm_starter.sky_sprint.best = #sky_sprint.clock msm_starter.msm_timers

meta.notes: Run when a runner reaches the finish, while the clock runs: stops it and shows the time, and keeps it in msm_starter.sky_sprint.best when it is less than their best so far.
